mapper.select: select * from (SELECT RES.task_Id,RES.task_Name,RES.status,RES.create_time,AHP.user_id FROM dcws_normal_task RES INNER JOIN dcws_normal_task_user AHP ON RES.task_id = AHP.task_id ORDER BY RES.create_time DESC) t ${ew.getCustomSqlSegment}

select * from (SELECT distinct RES.task_Id,RES.task_Name,RES.status,RES.create_time,AHP.user_id FROM dcws_normal_task RES INNER JOIN dcws_normal_task_handle_his AHP ON RES.task_id = AHP.task_id where AHP.update_time is not null ORDER BY RES.create_time DESC) t ${ew.getCustomSqlSegment}
